up: List all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3137667. For each molecule, provide the molecule's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), its maximum phase (max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3137667';
